Golchin and Surdeanu (2023) employ meticulously crafted prompts to guide the model in generating specific text and ask an LLM to judge its similarity to the evaluation data, thereby confirming whether the model has memorized certain pieces of text. Specifically, one of the four candidate choices is masked and the model is prompted with detailed information to predict it by generation. Then, GPT-3.5/4 is employed to judge if the predicted choice essentially has the same meaning as the original one or not.
